# Mid-Florida Windows and Doors, LLC

> Replacement window and door installer serving Central Florida. Impact and non-impact windows, patio doors, French doors and entry doors from PGT, Simonton and Plastpro, with free in-home estimates and written warranties on installation.

## Company

- Legal name: Mid-Florida Windows and Doors, LLC
- Owner / Operator: Donald V. David
- Florida license: #CGC1533928 (specialty contractor)
- Phone: (888) 230-0243
- Alternate phone: (727) 432-1899
- Address: 2451 McMullen Booth Road, Ste. 258, Clearwater, FL 33759
- Hours: Monday–Saturday, 08:00–18:00
- Payments accepted: MasterCard, VISA, American Express
- Financing: available through Lightstream (see Financing below)
- Not affiliated with similarly named companies in other states

## What the company does

- Replaces windows and doors for single-family homes and condominiums
- Handles product selection through installation
- Provides free in-home consultations and written quotes
- Covers manufacturers' warranties plus a 3-Year Anniversary Inspection Program on workmanship
- Offers hurricane impact protection and energy-efficiency upgrades
- Works with homeowners on Florida insurance-related impact window upgrades

## Products

Windows
- PGT WinGuard 5500 — impact-resistant
- PGT EnergyVue 5400 — non-impact, energy efficient
- Simonton Stormbreaker Plus — impact-resistant
- Simonton Collection Series — vinyl replacement windows

Doors
- PGT and Simonton sliding patio doors
- French doors
- Entry doors and sidelights
- Plastpro fiberglass doors
- Schlage locksets

Services
- Vinyl replacement windows
- Impact (hurricane) windows
- Energy-efficient window and door replacement
- Patio door, French door and entry door installation
- Removal and disposal of old windows and doors
- Flashing, sealing and finish work
- 3-Year Anniversary Inspection Program

## Service area

Counties served: Pinellas, Hillsborough, Polk, Orange, Pasco, Manatee, Sarasota, Hernando.

Cities referenced on the site: Clearwater, Tampa, St. Petersburg, Brandon, Lakeland, Sarasota.

## Frequently asked questions

Q: What areas does Mid-Florida Windows and Doors serve?
A: Central Florida, including Pinellas, Hillsborough, Polk, Orange, Pasco, Manatee, Sarasota and Hernando counties.

Q: What window and door brands are carried?
A: PGT WinGuard 5500 impact windows, PGT EnergyVue 5400 non-impact windows, Simonton Stormbreaker Plus impact windows, Simonton Collection Series, PGT and Simonton patio doors, French and entry doors, Plastpro doors and Schlage locksets.

Q: Are in-home quotes free?
A: Yes. A product specialist visits the home for a free consultation and quote. Call (888) 230-0243 to schedule.

Q: Are impact windows worth it in Florida?
A: They provide storm protection, may reduce homeowners insurance costs, improve energy efficiency and add long-term value.

Q: Is there a warranty?
A: Products carry manufacturers' warranties from PGT, Simonton and Plastpro, plus a 3-Year Anniversary Inspection Program on installation.
